learn.canDo: Explain what fills a coding agent's context and keep a long session healthy with lean setup, subagents and compaction.
learn.why: Coding agents are the most common daily use of AI engineering. Context management is what separates good sessions from bad.
learn.keyIdea: One window holds everything; the permanent part is rent.

learn.canDo: Brief a coding agent with tests, constraints, files and a plan so each change is small and reviewable.
learn.why: Directing an agent is delegation. Reviewers who brief well get better changes in less time.
learn.keyIdea: Give it a way to know it is wrong.

chapter.story: The team starts using a coding agent on the codebase and learns that the quality of the work depends on how it is directed.
outcomes: Explain how a coding agent uses its context
Keep long sessions lean with subagents
Brief an agent so changes are small and verifiable
chapter.why: A coding agent is the agent loop with a code editor. Its limits are the context window and the quality of the brief.
chapter.payoff: In an interview you can describe how you work with coding agents. At work you will get better changes in fewer rounds.
